title: Observability and tracing (what exists, what does not)
banner: CANDIDATE ORACLES, SYNTHETIC DATA, TEST-ONLY KEYS. NOT THE PLATFORM (it does not exist). No Azure resource is involved.

lines.text: NOT IMPLEMENTED: no correlation ids, structured logs, distributed traces, metrics, token usage, queue depth or dashboards exist. There is no running system to instrument.
What does exist and runs: a hash-chained audit trail of every lifecycle action, allowed or denied. Real entries from the flow just executed:
#1 09:45  agent   agent-evidence  create   NONE -> DRAFT  allowed  888ba68d9380
#2 09:45  agent   agent-evidence  submit   DRAFT -> EVIDENCE_PENDING  allowed  8129ec485215
#3 09:45  service svc-validator   validate EVIDENCE_PENDING -> VALIDATED  allowed  bd88222eb882
#4 09:50  human   qm-1            approve  VALIDATED -> APPROVED  allowed  83a9bbfb8c03
#5 09:50  service svc-issuer      issue    APPROVED -> ISSUED  allowed  a2d87f429e67
chain verifies: true. The specification the future build must meet is in docs/phase/AZURE-DEPLOYMENT-READINESS-REVIEW.md section 7.
